title: Warning: Do Not Play
description: Terror strikes when a fledgling director investigates claims of a cursed student film.

title: The Found Footage Phenomenon
description: Chartering the origins, impact, and legacy of the found footage subgenre. Filmmakers look at precisely what has made these films so popular and expose the sometimes sophisticated social and cultural nuances that make the films tick.

title: Found Footage 3D
description: A film crew making a found footage horror movie find themselves in a horror movie when an evil entity escapes into their footage.

title: The Cleansing Hour
description: Two entrepreneurs stage elaborate fake exorcisms until one of their girlfriends becomes possessed by a demon.

title: The Furies
description: Kidnapped and afraid, a woman finds herself fighting to stay alive as an unwilling participant in a deadly game where women are hunted by masked men.

title: Host
description: Six friends accidentally invite the attention of a demonic presence during an online séance and begin noticing strange occurrences in their homes.

title: Shook
description: When Mia, a social media star, becomes the target of an online terror campaign, she has to solve a series of games to prevent people she cares about from getting murdered.

title: Sam Was Here
description: A man begins to question his own sanity while traveling through a seemingly deserted and hostile desert environment.

title: Random Acts of Violence
description: A New Yorker who longs for the "good old days" starts a crime wave that he hopes will drive down real-estate prices and lure creative people back to the city.

title: The Ranger
description: A group of Punk-styled friends, fueled by a hallucinogenic drug called Echo, runs afoul of the law and an unhinged park ranger.
